tasks.name: 不召回近楼层
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== 楼层边界 N（持久化到 extension_settings）======
(async () => {
    // ====== 修改这里 ======
    const N = 22;   // 最近 N 楼禁召（含第 N 楼）；0 = 关闭
    // =====================

    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/retrieval/floor-boundary.js');

    if (!Number.isInteger(N) || N < 0) throw new Error('N 必须是 >= 0 的整数');

    const applied = mod.setFloorBoundaryLookback(N);

    const chat = SillyTavern?.getContext?.().chat;
    if (Array.isArray(chat) && chat.length) {
        const b = mod.resolveFloorBoundary(chat);
        console.info(b.enabled
            ? `[Floor Boundary] N=${applied}，禁召 floor >= ${b.blockedFrom}（最新 ${b.latestFloor}）`
            : `[Floor Boundary] 已关闭（N=${applied}）`);
    }

    window.toastr?.success(`✅ 楼层边界已保存: N = ${applied}`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
